notes.title: Upper East Dunes Momay Boss Battle Update
notes.notes:
[u][b]What's New![/b][/u]

[b]--0.9.3.0--[/b]
[list]
[*] New Level Upper East Dunes/Momay Boss Battle.
[*] Presidents covenant advantage for boss fight (last time it was the believers covenant with the advantage, next time will be neutral no covenant advantage).
[*] Fix for super energy potion during QTE events (deep ocean) where it can no longer be used during QTE to avoid "S" button conflicting with down arrow.
[*] Added completion journal mission task cross out for east dunes.
[*] Fix for mission cross out from continuously showing even when quests were complete and levels were replayed (deep ocean).
[*] Fix for goggles was not working on East Dunes level.
[*] 1 New Achievement.
[*] Memory World A.I. images redone (2, more will continue to be redone each patch until no more A.I. images exist in the game).
[/list]

Here is a look at the remade art:

[u][b]The Library[/b][/u]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/KcvWz0P9/before-after-library.png[/img]

[u][b]Computer Room[/b][/u]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/sp8y2BcN/before-after-cpu.png[/img]

[u][b]Previous patch[/b][/u]

[b]--0.9.2.9--[/b]
[list]
[*] New quests added(The East Side partially completable and The Fire Side in development).
[*] New level added The East Dunes.
[*] Level cap increased to 17.
[*] 3 New Achievements added.
[*] Issue fixed where keeper shows during game cutscenes if the player can level up and hasn't chosen to yet.
[*] Issue fixed where shield spell can activate during cutscene, cutting off cutscene sound.
[*] Boneyard Docks images redone.
[*] XP spec fix when looting in Bottom Deep Ocean to gain XP.
[*] Fix when summoning keeper to mute journal log dialogue which plays on some levels when entering so both aren't playing at the same time.
[/list]

[u][b]Next patch[/b][/u]

[b]--0.9.3.1--[/b]
[list]
[*] Memory World 2
[*] New side quest (possibly the last one).  Thought of making more but I think it is time to focus on main quests, and finishing the game, and any added DLC (if any) will come at a later time.
[*] 2-3 New Achievements.
[/list]

[u][b]Requests way down the line...[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Intro video and new game video sound fix for being too loud, and subtitles to be added.  
[*] Plans to redo new game cutscene so no A.I. exists.
[*] New/real voice actors instead of A.I. if possible.
[*] Overall sound focused fixing.
[/list]

*Note: Items will continue to improve such as icons, and positions.  Feedback is key to seeing better changes.

[/list]

[u][b]Previous Update (released yesterday):[/b][/u]

[b]--0.9.2.3--[/b]
[list]
[u][b]Brand new UI with the following changes:[/b][/u]
[*] New mini map and tips, clean portrait look, new icons for player buffs, and enemy debuffs, new exit portal spell icon, new gold icon, changes to inventory and placements, new macros for super energy potion, and portal, new health look, new hud/combat look and positioning.
[*] New spell that casts exit and can be cancelled.
[*] New keeper icon and light up when you are able to level.  The keeper will now be available to select to level up when you can actually level up, this helps remove clutter.
[*] Most all text back to times new roman to avoid users having to install fonts.
[*] Near instant game load start screen, no more long loading screens or video.
[*] Main menu changes.  New game now only plays the game intro.  Load game can be done on main menu screen and still the option after starting new game.  New macros.
[*] Ballroom Ball side quest changes and repositions.
[*] Revamp of all A.I. story board art to realism (Ballroom, Castle Doors, Boat At Island, and more).  Few more changes to go and all A.I. art will finally be gone, and only exclusive art created by our artist.
[*] Major progression stoppage issue on all maps if gold was the last drop and looted when completing a level.
[*] Meditate now has a 1 minute cooldown.  This was done to avoid spamming day passes, but also takes a more strategic approach to levels rather than attempting any strategy, and quitting right away to go meditate.
[*] Game size reduction
[*] New game icon
[*] Added auto play of newer quests dialogue with sound icon when entering level for the first time.  Sound icon is placed and clickable to replay dialogue without having to go to journal, and incase the dialogue sound was interrupted.
[*] Fix to not allow "C" macro to work unless you purchased or earned Goggles on East Goldencoast, when boss blinds you.  Previously there was no indication how to activate the goggles.
[*] New in combat screen effects, and defeated screen effects.
[*] New left click anywhere to continuously attack or back out with right click, right click creatures to instantly begin battle.
[*] Faster loading game saves.
[*] New center screen for higher than 1920x1080 resolutions.
[*] Large amount of fixes and changes that weren't completely tracked.
[/list]

notes.title: XP Creatures Update + Fixes
notes.notes:
[u][b]What's New[/b][/u]

[b]--0.9.1.8--[/b]

[list]

[*] Selecting a creature now shows the max amount of XP that can be earned from a creature, and the level until the creature will no longer give XP points.

[*] Fix for West Goldencoast tab target that disabled spider poison buff.

notes.notes:

[u][b]Quick Patch Fix[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Mana pot usage was unlimited, now limited based on pots appearing in inventory.  This issue was fixed long ago but the new UI broke it again, but it is fixed again.

notes.title: Full screen Map Revamp Update
notes.notes:
--0.9.0.1--

[u][b]Check out what's new:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] Boneyard level background redesigned
[*] Patch blocking the escape, map, and journal screens during in game cutscene on the Boneyard level.
[*] Fonts now included in main directory folder.  If requred, copy fonts to Windows directory: Control Panel\Appearance and Personalization\Fonts
[*] Full screen in-game map revamped.  You can now open a full screen map and see every other place you have discovered, including player indicator.  If you save or load a game before this patch, visit the latest level you unlocked, and then save again.  This will ensure your discovery of all the places you visited already. 
[*] No longer is the map dragable or in small view.
[*] Progress save fix for East Goldencoast, you must enter the level and then save to keep the progress.  Saving when unlocking East Goldencoast will not keep the progress on the next game load.
[/list]

[b]Major level patch delayed.  Due to feedback we decided to make changes to the Map.  Our next plan is to do some more changes before continuing level development.  We want to thank everyone who have left reviews, and personal messages with constructive feedback.  This game is building and improving based on community feedback and we really appreciate everyone.  Without the community this game would not continue to grow and succeed.[/b]

[u][b]In development:[/b][/u]

--0.9.0.2+--

[list]
[*] Full screen revamp of the journal (quest log).
[*] HUD UI revamp medieval themed.
[/list]

notes.title: Quick update:
notes.notes:
Quick update:

[list]
[*] Recently a white screen issue was fixed and a stealth patch was released. The stealth patch locked some further gameplay puzzles on a boat which was meant to be later on in the game.  Big patch is still getting worked on. The plan was to release West Goldencoast next. It is actually in the game but under testing (not playable). May delay so that a bigger update can release so there's more progression content rather than just 1 new level. One new level isn't complete without the boss fight being defeatable and without releasing the shop, it wouldn't be possible to get passed phase 2 in the East Goldencoast if released at current state.

[*] Next patch plans: West Goldencoast, East Goldencoast, Roseyard (side quest level), The Dunes, new shop, The Memory World 2, Return to Castle (planning additional optional side quest), The Ghost Lands. More achievements, achievements for current side quests that are playable but not fully complete (key drops/achievements, polish). Level cap raised from 11 to 16.
[/list]
